name: We Norwegians
band_note: mean of sweater entry $249 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Merino and cashmere sweaters, base layers, ski jackets and pants for women and men, sweaters around $300–500, sold through its own stores, website and ski and specialty shops.
origin: Founded in 2013 by Tove Grane; Øyvind Lauritzen.

quote.q: Their vision was to showcase modern Norway through fashion—not only through the use of natural, luxurious materials but also through its people and culture.

opview: “Their vision was to showcase modern Norway through fashion—not only through the use of natural, luxurious materials but also through its people and culture.” — We Norwegians (house), About Us, wenorwegians.us

facts_read.source: brand site; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

Sweater.lp: Blefjell Crewneck Women - Pure Cashmere (regular; marked to $124.50)

Dress.lp: Medalist Piqué Dress Women (regular; marked to $104.40)

doors.note: US: 2 own doors, Park City UT (675 Main St) and Aspen CO (465 E Hopkins Ave), both on the US contact page and as 'We Norwegians' rows in the locator feed. The global site (wenorwegians.com) lists Voss, Norway and Park City only; it also has a London in-store sign-up page but gives no London address. The US locator holds 37 rows, all US: the 2 own stores and 35 wholesale accounts (mostly ski and golf shops) in return_stockists.csv. Worklist site_domain NC; the brand runs a separate US site, wenorwegians.us.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across 6 product-type groups, proportional; 118 styles from 122 women's clothing listings in /products.json (241 total; men's, accessori

tech_evidence.names: Südwolle merino yarn (17.5 micron) with Creora Eco-Soft on the Sno base layers; CoolMax blend on the Medalist piqué
tech_evidence.share: 8% of sample (6 of 79) uses a named licensed fibre or yarn

craft_evidence.makers: no ('carefully selected suppliers'; Nepal cashmere capsule by unnamed artisans)
craft_evidence.mills: yes — Südwolle (yarn spinner) on the Sno merino base layers
craft_evidence.madein: 4% (3 of 79: China 2, Nepal 1); some base layers elsewhere state 'Knitted in Denmark, cut & sewn in Poland'
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — founded 2013, launched 2014 in Norway by Tove Grane and Øyvind Lauritzen; first US store Park City 2018
craft_evidence.process: thin — yarn count, micron and fabric weight given for base layers; 'traditional Norwegian knitting techniques' claimed without detail
craft_evidence.reasoning: One line names its yarn mill (Südwolle) and some base layers say where they are knitted and sewn (Denmark, Poland). The knitwear core names no maker or country, and the about page speaks only of 'carefully selected suppliers', so it's a 2.
